references.text: Esau settled in the Seir mountains. Esau is the ancestor of the Edomites, who are the same 'sons of Esau' that the Israelites were to pass by.
Jacob sent messengers to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, in the region of Edom. This confirms that Esau's descendants lived in Seir.
Israel asked for permission to pass through Edom's land but was refused. This provides background for the warning to be careful when passing by Esau's descendants.
Israel shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is their brother. This emphasizes the kinship between Israel and Esau's descendants.
The birth of Esau and Jacob as twin brothers. Esau became the ancestor of the Edomites, who are here called 'their brothers'.
Obadiah prophesies judgment against Edom (Esau's descendants) for their treatment of their brother Jacob.
The continuation of the verse explaining that Israel should not challenge the Edomites, for God has given the Seir mountains to Esau as a possession.
